steps.say: WEV Jevifies any local model: inspect, decide, gate, export
Inspect: type a prompt, see next-token probabilities and entropy
Decide: stream held-out tickets; typed label plus confidence per item
Measured accuracy at coverage, with the limits panel
Copy the gate wrapper to paste into your app
Load a sample receipt and verify it
Recompute the hash and the verdict from the pinned inputs
Flip one hash character and watch tamper detection fire
Re-verify: the same receipt now reads TAMPERED
